title: A 5' UTR Language Model for Decoding Untranslated Regions of mRNA and Function Predictions

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《A 5' UTR Language Model for Decoding Untranslated Regions of mRNA and Function Predictions》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】The 5' UTR, a regulatory region at the beginning of an mRNA molecule, plays a crucial role in regulating the translation process and impacts the protein expression level.

evidence.text: The 5' UTR, a regulatory region at the beginning of an mRNA molecule, plays a crucial role in regulating the translation process and impacts the protein expression level.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《A 5' UTR Language Model for Decoding Untranslated Regions of mRNA and Function Predictions》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-4】The UTR-LM is pre-trained on endogenous 5' UTRs from multiple species and is further augmented with supervised information including secondary structure and minimum free energy.

evidence.text: The UTR-LM is pre-trained on endogenous 5' UTRs from multiple species and is further augmented with supervised information including secondary structure and minimum free energy.

sections.title: 主要结果
sections.text:
《A 5' UTR Language Model for Decoding Untranslated Regions of mRNA and Function Predictions》：结果的原文依据；数值与适用人群以引文为准。

【Abstract · abstract-1-9】Experiment results confirmed that our top designs achieved a 32.5% increase in protein production level relative to well-established 5' UTR optimized for therapeutics.

evidence.text: Experiment results confirmed that our top designs achieved a 32.5% increase in protein production level relative to well-established 5' UTR optimized for therapeutics.
